meta.summary: A browser extension that enhances Modrinth on the website and beyond.

popup.title: Every feature, one click away
popup.description: Every feature can be individually toggled from the extension popup, so you can build the exact Modrinth experience you want.

cardActions.title: Act without leaving the list
cardActions.description: Download, follow, save, and copy links for projects directly from their cards, no need to open each page.

galleryBackground.title: A page that matches the project
galleryBackground.description: Display a project's featured gallery image as a full banner background, so shaders and resource packs look the part.

notifications.title: Notifications, right in the header
notifications.description: View, manage, and clear unread notifications without leaving the page you're on, with optional browser notifications and an unread badge on the extension icon.

dependencyExplorer.title: Explore the full dependency tree
dependencyExplorer.description: An interactive graph lets you dig through a project's required, optional, and embedded dependencies, as deep as you want to go.

quickSearch.title: Find anything in seconds
quickSearch.description: Press Ctrl+K or / to open a command palette style search, with faceted tags for loaders, versions, categories, and types built right into your query.

sparkline.title: See how active a project really is
sparkline.description: A release activity sparkline on every project page shows update frequency at a glance, before you even scroll down.

sidebar.title: The full picture, right in the sidebar
sidebar.description: Repository stars, issues, and pull requests. Discord member counts. Every modpack a mod is featured in. All shown right in the sidebar.
